info.name: Shinsou Sync API
info.description: Server endpoints (api/openapi.yaml): instance, auth, account, web, devices, sync, library, social, reviews, moderation and admin. Run Register or Login first; the test scripts store the tokens. The Web folder uses cookies (shinsou_refresh, shinsou_csrf) and the X-CSRF-Token header instead of a refresh token in the body. Admin requests need an administrator's token. Requires a server at {{baseUrl}}.

request.description: Open instances ignore inviteCode. For the first administrator send setupCode (logged by the server on first start) instead.
Rotates the refresh token. Sending an old one again signs the device out (refresh_token_reused).
Signs out every other device.

The token comes from the verification mail link: <PUBLIC_URL>/verify-email#token=<token>. 400 invalid_token when expired, used or the address changed. Repeating the call for an already verified address answers 204.
Answers 204 whether or not the address belongs to an account. 409 email_unavailable when the server has no SMTP. One mail per minute per account.
The token comes from the reset mail link: <PUBLIC_URL>/reset-password#token=<token>. Signs out every device.

Needs the current password. A new address starts unverified and receives a verification mail when the server can send mail. Send null to remove the address (422 email_required when verification is required). 429 rate_limited (with Retry-After) when a verification mail for this account went out less than a minute ago.

exec: pm.test('email is unverified after a change', () => pm.expect(j.emailVerified).to.eql(false));

request.description: 429 rate_limited (with Retry-After) inside the one-minute cooldown, 409 conflict when already verified, 409 email_unavailable without SMTP, 422 email_required without an address.
total counts tombstones; byKind lists live records of the seven kinds; quota is null when unlimited.
Everything stored for the account as one JSON download (streamed). 403 email_unverified while verification is required and the address is not verified.
Permanently deletes the account with its devices and records. 409 last_admin for the only active administrator.

Same rules as /auth/register with platform web. The refresh token is only set as the HttpOnly cookie shinsou_refresh (Path=/api/v1/web); shinsou_csrf is the readable CSRF cookie. The cookies carry Secure when SHINSOU_PUBLIC_URL is https:// (or the request is TLS), and Postman only sends Secure cookies over https; for a local http server use an http:// SHINSOU_PUBLIC_URL.

exec: pm.test('refresh token is not in the body', () => pm.expect(j.refreshToken).to.be.undefined);
const csrf = pm.cookies.get('shinsou_csrf'); if (csrf) { pm.collectionVariables.set('csrfToken', csrf); }

request.description: Sets the same cookies as Web register.

exec: pm.test('refresh token is not in the body', () => pm.expect(j.refreshToken).to.be.undefined);
const csrf = pm.cookies.get('shinsou_csrf'); if (csrf) { pm.collectionVariables.set('csrfToken', csrf); }

header.description: Value of the shinsou_csrf cookie (the pre-request script fills it from the cookie jar).

request.description: Exchanges the shinsou_refresh cookie for a new access token and rotates both cookies. Needs the X-CSRF-Token header (the cookie's value), otherwise 403 csrf_failed. Do not run two refreshes at the same time: a replayed cookie signs the browser out.

exec: const csrf = pm.cookies.get('shinsou_csrf'); if (csrf) { pm.collectionVariables.set('csrfToken', csrf); }
pm.test('no refresh token in the body', () => pm.expect(j.refreshToken).to.be.undefined);

header.description: Value of the shinsou_csrf cookie (the pre-request script fills it from the cookie jar).

request.description: Signs the browser out and clears both cookies. Needs X-CSRF-Token when the refresh cookie is present.
Merges one library record and one unit record. 410 resync_required means: pull again with since=0.

exec: // Work key v1 (docs/spec/work-key.md): length-prefixed canonical string, SHA-256 hex.
const pkg = pm.collectionVariables.get('packageId'), src = pm.collectionVariables.get('sourceId'), rid = pm.collectionVariables.get('remoteId'), unit = pm.collectionVariables.get('unitRemoteId');
pm.collectionVariables.set('unitHash', CryptoJS.SHA256('u1|' + lp(pkg) + lp(src) + lp(rid) + lp(unit)).toString());
pm.collectionVariables.set('since', 0); // keep pulling from the start in this demo

request.description: Updates the descriptor of a work without sending records. language, sourceName and repositoryUrl describe the source: when they are null the server keeps the values it already has.

exec: // Work key v1 (docs/spec/work-key.md): length-prefixed canonical string, SHA-256 hex.
const pkg = pm.collectionVariables.get('packageId'), src = pm.collectionVariables.get('sourceId'), rid = pm.collectionVariables.get('remoteId'), unit = pm.collectionVariables.get('unitRemoteId');
pm.collectionVariables.set('unitHash', CryptoJS.SHA256('u1|' + lp(pkg) + lp(src) + lp(rid) + lp(unit)).toString());

request.description: Stores nextSince as the new cursor.
Server-sent events: data: {"seq":N}. Postman cannot hold a WebSocket here; the WebSocket form is the same URL with an Upgrade request.
Read-only view of synced library entries. 403 email_unverified while verification is required and the address is not verified. archived: exclude | include | only; sort: recent | title | added.
Entry with its work description and chapter states (at most 5000).
Ordered by order, then name.

item.name: Social
item.description: Follows, blocks and sharing works between accounts on the same server (docs/spec/sharing.md). Set targetUserId to another account first, for example from Search users. The share endpoints answer 403 feature_disabled while the operator has sharing turned off.

request.description: Active accounts whose user name starts with q. The caller and accounts that blocked the caller are never listed.
Accounts the caller follows, newest first.
Idempotent. 404 when the account does not exist, is suspended or blocks the caller; 409 user_blocked when the caller blocks it.
Idempotent.
Accounts that follow the caller, newest first.
Accounts the caller blocks, newest first.
Idempotent. Both accounts stop following each other and the open shares from the blocked account are dismissed.
Idempotent. Follows are not restored.
Who may share works with the caller.
receiveFrom: everyone | following | nobody.
box: inbox (default) or sent. status: pending, accepted or dismissed. A sender never sees that a share was dismissed.
The work must be in the caller's library. 201 for a new share, 200 when the same share is still open. 403 share_refused, 409 user_blocked, 422 unknown_work, 429 rate_limited.
Number of received shares waiting for an answer.
Recipient only. Adds the work to the caller's library and marks the share accepted; repeatable. 409 quota_exceeded when the library is full.
Recipient only. 409 conflict when the share was accepted already.
Either side; removes the share for both.

item.name: Reviews
item.description: Reviews, ratings, helpful marks, replies and reports (docs/spec/reviews.md). Set workHash to a work some account has synced; writing the first review needs the work in your library. The two visitor requests send no token and answer 200 only while visitor browsing is on. All requests answer 403 feature_disabled while the operator has reviews turned off.

request.description: Work, rating summary, the caller's own review and inLibrary. Needs a work some account has synced (404 otherwise). 403 feature_disabled while reviews are off.
Same request without a token. Answers 200 only while visitor browsing is on (features.visitorBrowsing); otherwise 401 unauthorized.
Visible reviews plus the caller's own, newest first or most helpful first. Stores the first review id in reviewId.
Same request without a token; needs visitor browsing.

201 for the first review, 200 for an edit. The first review needs the work in the caller's library (422 unknown_work). rating 1-5 or null, body up to 5000 characters in a small Markdown subset, at least one of the two. 429 rate_limited at the daily cap.
Deletes the caller's review with its replies, votes and reports. 404 when there is none.
The caller's own reviews with their works, latest edit first, hidden ones included.
Idempotent. 422 on the caller's own review.
Idempotent.
Oldest first. Works without a token while visitor browsing is on. Stores the first reply id in replyId.
One level only; 1-2000 characters. 403 forbidden when the review's author blocks the caller. 429 rate_limited at the daily cap.
Only the reply's author; anybody else gets 404.

reason: spam, harassment, spoiler, illegal or other; note up to 500 characters. 201 for a new report, 200 when the caller already has an open one. 422 on the caller's own review. Stores the id in reportId.
Same rules as reporting a review.

item.name: Moderation
item.description: Report queue, hiding and deleting content, and suspending accounts. Requires a moderator's or administrator's token (403 forbidden otherwise); set targetUserId, reviewId, replyId and reportId first. Available while reviews are turned off.

request.description: Moderators and administrators only (403 otherwise). Oldest first; open is the number of open reports. Works while reviews are off.
Latest resolution first.
action: dismiss, hide or delete. Closes every open report on the same target. 409 already_resolved when answered already.
status hidden (default) or visible.
reason is required (1-500 characters); the author sees it. Answers with the review.
Makes the review visible again.
Deletes the review with its replies, votes and reports. The body is optional.
status hidden (default) or visible.
reason is required (1-500 characters).
Makes the reply visible again.
The body is optional.
reason is required. Moderators may suspend ordinary users, administrators also moderators; administrators cannot be suspended here (403). Signs out the account's devices.
Restores the account.
Administrators only (403 forbidden otherwise).
q matches username or email.
Send only the keys to change. Suspending signs the user out everywhere. 409 last_admin when it would remove the last active administrator; 422 for emailVerified=true without an address.
Signs the user out on every device.
Permanently deletes the account. 409 last_admin for the last active administrator.
Newest first, including used-up and expired invites. Codes are never listed.
The plain code is returned only here. expiresInHours may be null for no expiry.
Revokes the invite; accounts already created with it are unaffected.
values are the effective settings, defaults come from the environment, overridden lists the keys stored in the database.
Takes effect immediately. null resets a key to its environment default. sharing: enabled | disabled. emailVerification=required needs SMTP (409 email_unavailable).
Newest first.
